say:1:1013106001:1.text: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!
say:1:1013106001:1.source_cn: 主人，我看到了黑金商会的徽记……看起来，这里是黑金商人...
say:1:1013106001:1.male: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!
say:1:1013106001:1.female: Chippy sees the emblem of the Adamant Syndicate...looks like this is a camp for their merchants!

say:3:1013106002:0.text: The Adamant Syndicate has been getting stronger lately. Do you know anything about that?
say:3:1013106002:0.source_cn: 黑金商会近些年势头很盛。看你们的样子……是否有什么我们...

choice_prompt:4:1013106002.text: The Adamant Syndicate has been getting stronger lately. Do you know anything about that?
choice_prompt:4:1013106002.source_cn: 黑金商会近些年势头很盛。看你们的样子……是否有什么我们需要知道的情况？

say:5:1013106003:3.text: They've been causing lots of trouble for the Wilders in the Dark Forest.
say:5:1013106003:3.source_cn: 他们在薄暮丛林里，对绿裔做了一些坏事。

say:7:1013106004:1.text: Dura above, how could this happen... Have the Wilders been harmed?
say:7:1013106004:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，竟然有这种事……绿裔子民们没有受到伤害吧？

say:8:1013106005:1.text: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!
say:8:1013106005:1.source_cn: 好在主人阻止得及时，没有造成更大的危害！
say:8:1013106005:1.male: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!
say:8:1013106005:1.female: No, thankfully. The magister came in to save the day!

say:9:1013106009:1.text: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.
say:9:1013106009:1.male: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.
say:9:1013106009:1.female: We should consider the information provided by <style="stress"><player_name></style> and proceed cautiously.

say:10:1013106010:2.text: Of course... I won't act recklessly. Temesia, you're always more composed than me.
say:10:1013106010:2.source_cn: 啊，当然……我不会贸然行动的。特弥希娅，你总是比我稳重。

say:12:1013106006:3.text: The Syndicate was studying some strange corruption, changing the Wilders' plants into something grotesque!
say:12:1013106006:3.source_cn: 他们好像在研究一些奇怪的污染，把绿裔的植物都改变得好恶心！

say:14:1013106007:1.text: Dura above, how could this happen?! Have the Wilder residents been affected?
say:14:1013106007:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，怎会如此？绿裔的居民们受到影响了吗？

say:15:1013106008:1.text: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!
say:15:1013106008:1.source_cn: 主人帮助他们清除了污染，丛林现在更美了！
say:15:1013106008:1.male: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!
say:15:1013106008:1.female: Don't worry! The magister helped them clear the corruption, and now the forest looks even more beautiful!
